figure_4.selection: Conservative engineering-model inference: select the plotted 290 N/mm2 curve as the lower factor envelope for every actual fs not exceeding 290 N/mm2, then select the next higher percentage bracket. This is not exact Figure 4 interpolation or a quoted code formula.
figure_4.precision: Factors are rounded downward to 0.1 from visual source readings. The profile is intentionally conservative and must not be presented as exact curve interpolation.
